title: Keysight Vector Signal Generator
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER > FA8222  AFSC PZIE
description: This acquisition supports the F-16 Block 30 and F-16 Block 50 programs under the 518th Software Engineering Squadron(SWES). The requirement is for a Keysight M9484C VXG Vector Signal Generator, including the specified options/add-ons.This acquisition is intended as a sole source award to Keysight. See attached justification for more information.The government will consider potential alternatives submitted in response to this RFQ.
